newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus February inflation halved to 6.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Belarus February inflation halved to 6.6 pct.

text.p: Belarus monthly inflation slowed to 6.6 percent in February from 13.3 percent the previous month, Statistics Ministry data showed on Wednesday.
BELARUSSIAN CONSUMER PRICES Feb 97 Jan 97 Feb 96
The president's press secretary, Valery Tolkachov, on Tuesday put February inflation at six percent and said the slowdown in inflation was due to the government regulating food prices.
An economic plan decreed by President Alexander Lukashenko said monthly inflation should not exceed two percent in 1997.
